prose.subject: Invoice INV-78279 and Payout Account Update
prose.body:
Hi Rafael,

I hope you are having a productive week. I am writing to share invoice INV-78279 for our recent collaboration, totaling 3579.25 USDC. Please find the document attached for your records.

Additionally, I wanted to inform you that we have recently updated our treasury setup. We have added a new payout account, elmsteadsecurity12-treasury.testnet, which is now linked to our domain elmstead-security.example. For any future payments, kindly ensure this new account is used to streamline our reconciliation process. The old account remains valid for a short transition period, but we recommend switching to the new one immediately to avoid any delays in processing.

If you have any questions regarding the invoice details or the new account information, please do not hesitate to reach out. We appreciate your continued partnership with Elmstead Security and look forward to our next project.

Best regards,
Sofia Rossi
Elmstead Security
